dialect.detail: Likely GnuCOBOL with ODBC/ESQL (ecob or similar preprocessor); uses EXEC SQL with ODBC DSN connection string, scroll cursor, ROW_NUMBER() window function. French-language identifiers and comments. Program-id uses AS clause for external name 'FaStock.Consult'.

purpose.domain_detail: Stock/inventory management system (FaStock) - consultation of articles by supplier with pagination and detail drill-down
purpose.summary: This program implements a supplier article consultation module for a stock management application called FaStock. It connects to an ODBC database, loads paginated lists of articles belonging to a named supplier using SQL cursors, displays them on screen, and allows the user to navigate pages or drill into stock detail for a specific article reference.

notable_features: EXEC SQL with ODBC DSN connection string (Server=localhost;Database=Fastock;dsn=Fastock)
EXEC SQL DECLARE INSENSITIVE SCROLL CURSOR
SQL ROW_NUMBER() window function for pagination
SCREEN SECTION with dynamic LINE/COL display
program-id AS clause for external name
No COPY statements, no CALL statements
SQLCA included via EXEC SQL INCLUDE
verdict.notes: Only DATA DIVISION and PROCEDURE DIVISION are present (no IDENTIFICATION or ENVIRONMENT divisions shown, though program-id appears at top suggesting IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header may be omitted). The SQL logic has a potential bug: 'if sqlcode not equal 100 or sqlcode not equal 101' is always true due to OR logic. French comments and identifiers suggest a French-speaking developer/student project. Could be a student project given the FaStock application context, but the structure is reasonably complete.
